title: ENCODEURL percent-encodes tilde (~) as %7E, leaves only [A-Za-z0-9.-_] unencoded, and returns #VALUE! past 32,767 UTF-16 units
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, ENCODEURL(text) percent-encodes the UTF-8 bytes of text using uppercase hex for every byte except ASCII letters, ASCII digits, '-', '.', and '_'—notably encoding '~' as %7E (unlike RFC 3986 unreserved characters) and spaces as %20. Numbers and logicals coerce to text as '&' does (ENCODEURL(TRUE) -> "TRUE"), and an encoded output exceeding 32,767 UTF-16 code units returns #VALUE! (LEN(ENCODEURL(REPT(UNICHAR(233),5000))) -> 30000, while 6000 -> #VALUE!). All 3,064 full-bank ENCODEURL rows match.
basis: Measured across all 115 ENCODEURL rows of DnaCalc dcuar_text and jnt_text_formats rows 194-196 (Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 3,064/3,064 full-bank rows match.
